basis: Cardiac malformations and pectus abnormalities characterize NS6; motor delay 9/12 and intellectual disability 2/5 support neurologic involvement. Pigment changes do not establish skin damage.
Juvenile neurodegenerative disease with basal ganglia neuronal loss, movement abnormalities, seizures and cognitive decline.
Congenital heart malformations define this subtype; intestinal malrotation 2/3, asplenia 1/3 and corpus callosum agenesis 1/3 support additional axes.
Syndromic neurodevelopmental disorder; high myopia in 1/2 supports ocular involvement. Recurrent otitis is a separate infection.
Congenital noncommunicating, nonfunctional lung tissue defines the disease; systemic arterial supply does not establish additional cardiovascular damage.
Defined by congenital eye defects, valvular disease and skeletal/muscle abnormalities; these three systems constitute the syndrome.
Inherited susceptibility to persistent cutaneous HPV infection causes chronic skin lesions; subsequent skin cancer is a separate disease.
Skin, eyelid/lacrimal and oral cleft defects define AEC; conductive hearing loss occurs in 80-99%. Reported choanal atresia omitted at the four-axis cap.
Congenital skin and subcutaneous atrophy; joint hypermobility 80-99% and scoliosis 30-79% support musculoskeletal involvement; supplied HPO reports intellectual disability in 30-79%.
Congenital urinary obstruction dilates the renal collecting system and can cause renal atrophy.
Extreme insulin resistance; skin/nail changes and fat loss, developmental disability, and dental abnormalities each occur in 30-79%. Nephrocalcinosis is under 30%.
The definition includes severe spondyloepimetaphyseal skeletal dysplasia, hypodontia and intellectual disability.
Sarcoma arising in or occupying the cerebral telencephalon.
Autoimmune inflammatory skin and muscle disease; interstitial lung disease affects roughly one-third or more in several anti-SAE cohorts, with substantial cohort variation.
Factor H dysfunction causes complement-mediated renal thrombotic microangiopathy with hemolytic anemia and thrombocytopenia.
Congenital cervical vertebral fusion defines MEOX1-related Klippel-Feil syndrome. Hearing, cardiac and palatal defects lack evidence of a 30% frequency in this subtype.
Down syndrome causes neurodevelopmental disability; congenital heart defects ~50%, hearing impairment ~50-75%, and ocular/refractive abnormalities >50%.
Inherited platelet adhesion defect with macrothrombocytopenia and bleeding; bleeding sites do not establish separate organ disease.
Immune-mediated rheumatic inflammation of the pericardium.
Localized benign proliferation of dermal capillaries, defining both cutaneous and vascular origin.
Inherited macular retinal dystrophy with vitelliform lesions and reduced visual acuity.
Nonsyndromic X-linked intellectual disability; synophrys does not establish additional organ damage.
SERCA1-related disorders here are skeletal myopathies affecting muscle calcium handling; the broad neurologic ancestor does not establish nerve damage.
Hairy cell leukemia involving the spleen, a blood organ. The gastrointestinal lymphoma parent does not establish digestive tract involvement.
Immune dysregulation with cytopenias in 2/2; direct inflammatory lung and gut infiltration each reported in ~1/2. Eczematous skin disease omitted at the four-axis cap.
